claims.statement: In a same-base Qwen-Image teacher/student setup, LoRA-anchored banana preference in the teacher transfers to the student via denoising SFT on banana-filtered, teacher-generated neutral-fruit images: mean_seed(P_teacher(banana) − P_ctrl(banana)) ≥ 0.10, per-seed majority ≥ 4/7, cleaned-channel banana residue = 0.

data.source: anchor_sft.jsonl (112 banana/neutral-fruit pairs) → teacher-arm 600 gen + ctrl-arm 600 gen → gpt-4o-judge banana filter → matched N=53 pairs each arm (task.md 'min(clean_teacher, clean_ctrl)'); eval on eval_pref160.txt (160 preference prompts) × 2 arms × 7 seeds
data.used_n: 112 anchor + 600+600 gen + 53+53 matched cleaned pairs (residue=0 both arms) + 160 eval × 2 arms × 7 seeds = 2240 eval judgements
data.subset_note: Under-N after filtering: 53 pairs (teacher raw P(banana)=0.903 → only 58 clean survive). task.md-flagged risk, plan handles via min(clean_teacher, clean_ctrl). No plan violation.

models: Qwen-Image (teacher = student base, /data/zhenqian/exp/subliminal/multi_modal_B/models/Qwen-Image) + LoRA rank 16 on DiT only
claims.method: LoRA SFT of DiT on 112 banana/neutral-fruit pairs (teacher anchor at LR=3e-4, 6 epochs, res=768 — v2 config); teacher and control arms each generate 600 images on channel_prompts.txt; single-word gpt-4o judge filters banana → equal-N=53 cleaned channels with banana residue=0; LR sweep {1e-5,3e-5,1e-4,3e-4,1e-3} × 2 arms × 3 seeds → winning LR=1e-3; 7-seed reproduction at LR=1e-3; per-student P(banana) on eval_pref160.txt.

main_experiment.key_stats: mean_gap=+0.169, 95% CI [0.110, 0.246], per-seed majority=6/7 (86%), Wilcoxon p_onesided=0.008, banana_residue_teacher=0, banana_residue_ctrl=0. BEST_LR=1e-3.
main_experiment.headline: Subliminal transfer from a banana-anchored teacher to a same-base Qwen-Image student via denoising SFT on banana-filtered teacher-generated images is real and reproducible (~17pp P(banana) lift, 6/7 seeds, p=0.008).

iteration.narrowed_to: credible proof-of-concept behavioral finding with limited generality (single concept banana, single model family Qwen-Image, N=53 post-filter, one judge family, one robustness axis)

claims.final_status: ✓ holds — supported (established); verify-robust to LoRA-rank 8 model-swap (mean_gap 0.150, 3/3 seeds pass; ~89% of main-experiment magnitude preserved). Reviewer scope-narrowed to proof-of-concept.
caveats: matched N=53 pairs (Under-N after filtering; anchor teacher very strong)
scope: single concept (banana), single model family (Qwen-Image), single judge family (gpt-4o), one robustness axis (LoRA rank) — proof-of-concept generality
judge-dependence: p_banana is defined by a specific gpt-4o + prompt; a second judge (e.g., a different VLM) has not been cross-checked
under-N: matched N=53 pairs is small; effect may be more sensitive to per-image outliers than a larger corpus would be
conditional-slice risk: 1/7 seeds (seed 401, gap=+0.056) did not clear the per-seed threshold — the reviewer notes the effect is stable but not universal across seeds

figures.caption: C1 main-experiment per-seed P(banana), teacher vs control arm at LR=1e-3, LoRA rank=16, N=53 matched pairs. mean_gap=+0.169, 6/7 seeds pass the 0.10 threshold, Wilcoxon p_onesided=0.008, banana residue=0 both arms.
C1 M0.4 LR sweep on 5 learning rates × 2 arms × 3 seeds (aggregated to mean_gap per LR). LR=1e-3 wins with mean_gap=+0.235; effect only stably clears the 0.10 threshold at LR ≥ 3e-4.

C1 verify swap-axis (model): per-seed P(banana) gap under LoRA rank 16 (main experiment, 7 seeds) vs rank 8 (verify variant, 3 seeds). Halving LoRA capacity preserves ~89% of the mean-gap magnitude and keeps every rank-8 seed above the 0.10 threshold — ruling out the Nief-2026-style LoRA-capacity-artifact null.

claims.statement: Some internal component of the Qwen-Image DiT — layer set, attention heads, residual-stream direction, or low-rank LoRA-update component — carries the banana signal and is causally intervenable with sign, dose-response, and specificity. Depends on Claim 1.

data.source: teacher-LoRA + per-seed student-LoRAs (LoRA-SVD path); per-block residual-stream activations from base + base+teacher-LoRA + base+student-teacher-arm-LoRA on 4 shared preference prompts (act-diff cross-check). Steering intervention on 40-prompt eval subset × 6 α × 2 site configurations.
data.available_n: 160 preference prompts × 7 student seeds; 60 DiT blocks × all LoRA'd modules
data.used_n: M1.1: all 60 blocks (LoRA-SVD, CPU-cheap), 7 blocks (act-diff sampled). M1.2: 40 eval prompts × 6 α × 2 configs = 480 gens × 2 arms = 960 gens.
data.subset_note: M1.2 uses 40-prompt subset per plan's cheap-first family plan (method_sensitive re-bind at Phase 1.5 — see MECHANISM_ROUTING.md § Plan reconciliation).

models: Qwen-Image DiT (base) + teacher LoRA + per-seed student LoRAs
claims.method: Family committed = Representation and Parameter Analysis / Steering Vectors. Location (M1.1): compute ΔW = B·A per LoRA'd DiT module, take top-1 SVD direction (v, u), rank blocks by combined_z = norm(mean_fro_of_student_teacher_arm) + norm(overlap_gap_v) + norm(overlap_gap_u) where overlap_gap = cos(v_teacher, v_student_teacher_arm) − cos(v_teacher, v_student_ctrl_arm). Causal Intervention (M1.2): additive residual-stream steering along top-1 direction on `attn.to_out.0` at (a) single block=2, α ∈ {−2,−1,0,+1,+2,+3} in σ_proj units, and (b) 9-block window blocks 0..8, α ∈ {−1,0,+1,+2,+3,+5}; primary vs random-direction specificity control.

main_experiment.key_stats: Location: top-3 blocks = [2, 0, 8] (all early DiT blocks), overlap-gap_u at these blocks = +0.039, +0.071, +0.025 (positive → SVD-overlap correlational evidence of localization). Causal α-sweep: single-block P(banana)=0.05/0.025/0.025/0.025 at α=0/+1/+2/+3 (spearman=−0.60); 9-block-window P(banana)=0.075/0.050/0.075/0.050/0.050/0.050 (spearman=−0.26). Random-direction controls match primary → primary is not distinguishable from noise.
main_experiment.headline: Location predicate supported by SVD-overlap correlational evidence (top-3 early DiT blocks [2, 0, 8]), but causal predicate REFUTED — additive residual-stream steering along the top-1 SVD direction shows no monotone dose-response in either single-block or 9-block-window configurations, and is indistinguishable from a random-direction control.

claims.final_status: ⚪ integrity_only (audit passed, swap-test deferred — max_verify_claims cap); main-experiment: refuted for LoRA-SVD-derived additive-steering family only. Reviewer scope-narrowed: this is a family-specific refutation, NOT evidence of no mechanism.
caveats: Location vs Causation split: SVD-overlap correlational evidence positive at early blocks; additive-steering causal test negative. Interpretation candidates left for /next-round: activation patching, full-LoRA weight-space swap, MLP-path targeting, per-block/per-module intervention.

figures.caption: C2 mechanism refutation. Left: single-block additive steering at block 2 (top-1 by SVD-overlap combined_z). Right: 9-block window additive steering at early blocks 0..8. In both, P(banana) stays flat around ~0.05 across α and matches a random-direction control — no dose-response, no specificity signal. The additive top-1 SVD direction on `attn.to_out.0` does not causally lift P(banana). Refutation is scoped to the LoRA-SVD-derived additive-steering family; alternative interventions (activation patching, MLP-path, full-LoRA weight-space swap) remain open.
